description: Repairs r-sql-1/eq-cross-type, r-sql-1/eq-numeric-domains and r-sql-1/b-join-bound-types: ND was never created (3292). Asks which values group together and which representative and VARIANT type returns: GROUP BY the Decimal x of ND and the BIGINT v of NB; Currency/Decimal and BIGINT/Double through UNION ALL in both arm orders; and whether N.c = ND.x is admitted in an INNER JOIN ON and which rows match. The stored ND and NB rows are read first. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
